title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- HELPERS OF PURPOSE

excerpt.rendered: “And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3) That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy…

content.rendered:
“And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

Our Focal Scripture speaks of that moment when Mary told Jesus that the couple whose marriage feast they were attending had no more wine to give to the guests. Mary co-opted Jesus into the personal matter of the couple, and in the end, they got help. Mary and Jesus worked in agreement to make things happen for the couple. Mary and Jesus had a conversation for help to come the way of the couple.

Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: God will trigger conversations in your favour. Men you do not know will hold conversations on how to lift you higher; men that matter will hold conversations and work in agreement to make new things happen in your life; men that have the capacity to bring solutions your way will commit themselves to the purpose of moving you forward; men will commit themselves to your interest.

That couple made efforts to provide the much they could, but their wine finished, and they were nearly about to be disgraced when Mary got Jesus involved and saved the day. The involvement of Mary and Jesus saved them from shame. Hear me again: God will send you men who will get involved in your matters and save you from negative consequences. God will send you men who will save your purpose from collapse.

That couple had helpers in their party; they didn’t have spoilers who could overwhelm the helpers. Today, I pray for you: may you not be surrounded by spoilers of destiny. May you not be surrounded by men who will cause it to rain on your parade; may you not be surrounded by men who will scuttle your progress and undermine your efforts; may you not be surrounded by men whose presence will destroy your purpose/plans.

Ask God to send you men who will be committed to your purpose and plans. Ask God to send you men who will push your destiny forward.

Isaiah 60: 11 says: “Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.”

Declare With Me: I receive men who will help my purpose to advance; no room for spoilers, in Jesus’ name!
